text:
Maya R: Quick thought — the 'Create sample project' CTA on the out-of-box flow feels buried under the banner. Mock attached: https://figma.com/file/xyz — can we try a stronger visual treatment? @Aria (PM)

Aria (PM): Agree. Two approaches: primary teal button + small 'Skip' link, or show 3 inline sample project cards so users can pick a starter template.

Devon: Cards are 👍 but labels need to be clearer. People confuse 'example' vs 'template' — maybe use 'Use case' and a 1-line benefit.

Jon L: Accessibility nit — the card titles are visually treated like headings (<h4>) but aren't semantic in the mock. Screen readers end up reading order oddly. Need proper aria roles and semantic headings.

Maya R: Good catch. Also copy tweak suggestion: change "Get started with a sample" -> "Start with a sample project" (more action-oriented).

Zack: If we add 3 cards we should think about preloading a tiny manifest for the templates. Concern: first-run performance if we fetch full assets upfront. Suggest lazy load large assets, preload metadata.

Aria (PM): We can ship with lightweight placeholders and fetch full templates after onboarding completes. Note: product needs to sign off on storage/cost for pre-seeded templates.

Jon L: Banner contrast check: current token #00A38E on white fails WCAG AA at small sizes. Design should validate color tokens or add subtle dark overlay.

Devon: Proposing two variants to test: Variant A — full-width banner with centered primary CTA + secondary 'See examples' that opens a modal listing the 3 sample projects. Variant B — stacked cards directly below the banner (more discovery but adds vertical scroll).

Maya R: Let's run a small usability test (N=8) — 4 devs, 4 PMs — measure time to create first project and clarity of next step. @smoothbot can we instrument CTA clicks and modal opens?

smoothbot: Event created: onboarding.sample_cta.click with props {variant}. Will capture variant via query param.

Aria (PM): I'll pick Variant A for the canary rollout. UX will update the assets. New copy for the CTA mock: "Start with a sample project — deploy in under 2 minutes." Pls update before engineering handoff.

Jon L: Keyboard/Focus nit for the modal: current focus order puts the close button after the primary action. Fix: close should be first focusable element and trap focus inside modal. Also ensure Escape dismisses.

Maya R: :thumbsup: I'll update the Figma file and add the revised copy + accessibility checklist. Pinging eng for feasibility — @Zack please advise on preload strategy and ETA.

Zack: Implementation notes: backend needs a templates manifest endpoint + small zipped template blobs for fast download. Frontend can show placeholders and stream in content. Rough estimate: 2 days backend + 1 day frontend + 1 day QA for canary. Can ship canary in ~1 week if no blockers.

Maya R: Awesome — assigning follow-ups: Figma updates (Maya), copy finalization (Aria), accessibility checklist (Jon), backend manifest (Zack). Will schedule a 30m review sync next Tue.
